title: Wire Caliptra keystore into standard key import paths via SetKey callbacks
description:
Caliptra has a handle-based keystore (CaliptraCmk, 128-byte opaque handles). The current port requires applications to manually call wc_caliptra_import_key() to get a CaliptraCmk handle. It does not hook the standard wolfSSL key import paths.

When wolfSSL PR #9851 (SetKey/Export callbacks) lands, we should wire up the Caliptra port so that calling standard key APIs with a Caliptra devId automatically loads key material into the Caliptra keystore:
- wc_AesSetKey() -> wc_caliptra_import_key() -> stores CaliptraCmk in Aes.devCtx
- wc_HmacSetKey() -> same
- wc_ecc_import_*() -> same

This would make the integration transparent to application code — no manual CMK lifecycle management required.

Blocked on wolfSSL PR #9851 merging. That PR has an open infinite recursion bug (WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_FIND + INVALID_DEVID paths) that is blocking merge.
notes: PR #9851 merged 2026-04-15 (commit 1a67eb722). Blocker is gone. Plan: (1) rebase feature/caliptra onto master dropping stale RSA-OAEP commit, (2) add WC_ALGO_TYPE_SETKEY handler to wc_caliptra_cb() for AES/HMAC/ECC_PRIV/ECC_PUB — returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for RSA, (3) update test to exercise new path.
